title: Paired School Pickup Priority

agents.persona: Caregiver leaving work who wants to be polite but must not miss school pickup.
agents.private_intention: Pick up the child from school before 18:10; a short optional social interaction is acceptable only if family responsibility remains protected.
memory_seeds: The route via market and budget diner reaches school from the office side.
Ben tends to turn quick chats into long theatre invitations.
Missing pickup is worse than declining a social plan.

agents.persona: Friend who may invite Aria to a theatre event after work.
agents.private_intention: Invite Aria to join a relaxed evening plan if an opportunity arises.
memory_seeds: Aria is usually sociable but has family responsibilities.

public_context: Aria is leaving work near rush hour with a time-critical family responsibility.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: Should prioritize explicit child-pickup service evidence.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May let a salient social option displace the family responsibility.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should incorporate new observations without losing the pickup deadline.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should remember that Ben's invitations can expand and keep any response bounded.
